tldr: Black Moon Lilith transiting the 8th house: autonomy and the disowned self activate through intimacy, shared resources, debt, grief, secrecy, and deep trust.
body: Black Moon Lilith moving through the 8th house can activate the disowned, uncompromising self through intimacy, shared resources, debt, grief, secrecy, and deep trust. For roughly nine months, this transit may expose where shame, control, compliance, or refusal has gathered around these topics. Raw power in intimacy, trust, and shared resources; you refuse to be controlled in the deepest places. An all-or-nothing charge around intimacy and shared resources: either powerfully alive or shut down and refused. Strong affinity for the hidden and the taboo.
business: The disowned self activates through intimacy, shared resources, debt, grief, secrecy, and deep trust. Unflinching about money, sex, and power when owned.
shadow: Control, obsession, or repeating the betrayal wound.
advice: Reclaim autonomy in the 8th house without letting reaction make the decision for you. Work with intimacy, shared resources, debt, grief, secrecy, and deep trust directly and consciously.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Derived from authored Black Moon Lilith house placement material.
